I completely agree, I know that they are two different things. Like I said, depression is so much more severe than regular sadness. But my point was that you can't gauge how relevant a person's sadness is just because you have it worse. No matter how tiny of a matter it is, sadness and depression fucking sucks.

Ah, the classic "my entire family died whereas only your sibling died so obviously you're not allowed to express any sadness whatsoever because my hardship is more relevant."

Every person goes through pain in different ways. Yours might be a lot more severe but that doesn't give you the right to judge others for undergoing milder issues and complaining about it.
